name: JobHunt
author: JobHunt
description: See what needs you today in your job search, and your streak, right from the bar.

barWidget.description: One quiet number for what is due today (interviews, tasks, follow-ups), and a panel with today's items, your streak, your pipeline and hand-offs to your own agent. Needs the JobHunt command line tool and an account at jobhunt.app.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the JobHunt command is run in the background. It is also run when you open the panel.

schema.label: Hide company names
schema.description: For shared screens. Company names stay out of the panel and out of requests sent to your agent.

schema.label: Open links
schema.description: Open jobhunt.app in a browser tab, or in a dedicated web app window (needs a Chromium-based default browser).

schema.label: JobHunt command path
schema.description: Optional. Full path to the jobhunt command if it is not found on the shell's PATH.
